reuse.why: All six link handlers route through the new linkBankSyncAccount and reuse findOrCreateBank, syncAccount and handleSyncResponse, but the take-over path re-writes unlinkAccount's field reset instead of sharing it.

duplication.why: The five copied link bodies are collapsed into one helper, but the diff copies unlinkAccount's account-reset block and adds downloadFintegraTransactions as another near-copy of the Akahu/Pluggy download functions.

placement.why: Linking helpers live in accounts/app.ts next to the handlers, the Fintegra download in sync.ts and the URL in server-config, matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: Changes stay on linking and the Fintegra provider; widening DbAccount.account_sync_source to all providers is a small adjacent type fix.

maintainability.why: One linking definition with explicit fileId/eventTables variations is easy to own, though the guard must be remembered at every handler separately and 'ensure...' silently unlinks another account as a side effect.

bypasses_abstraction.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked writes the unlink field reset with db.updateAccount instead of going through unlinkAccount (or a shared extraction of its reset part), with a comment about avoiding the GoCardless requisition removal.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied unlink reset and the Fintegra download function are plain copies, not reshaped; the old link bodies were genuinely removed.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount stays generic (fileId and eventTables encode existing provider variations); later steps put the duplicate/closed/replace rules in a separate ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked helper that gains the replaceExistingLink parameter; every handler including Fintegra calls both helpers, none re-implements them.
